name: May Liddell Archelot
original_name: メイ・リデル・アーシェロット
source: An idol singer who has travelled around the world, May is also a mage with an eccentric personality. She is acquainted with Soujuurou by unknown means and is known by the church. As a mage, her ability is considerable enough to cause trouble for Lugh (who wasn't taking her on seriously when they fought).
